biothings.name: clivus chordoma
biothings.definition: A slow-growing malignant bone tumor arising from the remnants of the notochord and occurring in the clivus. It is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, myxoid stroma formation, and the presence of physaliphorous cells. [NCIT:P378]
biothings.synonyms: chordoma (disease) of clivus of occipital bone, chordoma of clivus, chordoma of the clivus, clival chordoma, clivus of occipital bone chordoma (disease)
